comments.author: @raptorshootingsystems3379
comments.text:
American flying multiple flights a day to LHR out of DFW codesharing with BA lets BA use their own aircraft to fly a codeshare with American out of Houston which is a United Fortress hub.  

BA gets the volume out of DFW into their hub using American’s aircraft while BA offers competition to United out of a United hub.  Most Houston customers are not going to want to connect through DFW.  

United offers 2 non-stops to LHR out of Houston and i know in the past, BA offered 2 flights as well.

comments.author: @vanKaneLio
comments.text: Multiple airlines flying to the same destination is a result of high demand, not the primary reason ticket prices are cheap. If a market has enough volume and profit potential, other airlines will naturally jump in for a slice of the pie. Demand density and scale dictate the baseline price; competition is just the natural byproduct.
